We note that “missing Americans” is a statistical construct; we cannot specify which deaths would have been averted, only the number that would have been averted if the United States had mortality rates of its peers.
We subtracted this number from the actual number of US deaths at each age to compute the number of excess US deaths each year, i.e. the number of missing Americans.
